entities.name: PMID:25422913
observations: British Journal of Cancer (2015): reports miR-1228 promotes hepatoma-cell proliferation, cell-cycle progression, mobility, and metastasis-related phenotypes; experiments included colony formation, transwell, and nude-mouse xenografts.
Reports miR-1228 binding to the p53 3′UTR, p53 rescue of miR-1228-induced phenotypes, and p53 suppression of miR-1228 expression/promoter activity.

entities.name: miR-1228
observations: In the HCC study, miR-1228 promoted cell proliferation, cell-cycle progression, and mobility; it downregulated p53 through its 3′UTR and was itself repressed by p53.

entities.name: TP53
observations: In the HCC study, p53 overexpression abrogated miR-1228-associated phenotypes; p53 suppressed miR-1228 expression and promoter activity, completing the reported positive-feedback loop.

entities.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
observations: The primary report investigated miR-1228 and p53 in hepatocellular carcinoma, including hepatoma cell lines, tumor tissue comparisons, and nude-mouse xenografts.
